title: The Ailing Planet: the Green Movement's Role

topics.title: The Green Movement and the holistic view of the earth

concepts.learning_objective: Recall how and when the Green Movement began and how widely it spread.
Explain the shift from a mechanistic to a holistic, ecological view of the earth as a living organism.

topics.title: Sustainable development and the world's most dangerous animal

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the 1987 definition of sustainable development and its meaning.
Interpret the Lusaka zoo notice and the shift from domination to partnership.
Identify the four principal biological systems and their role in the global economy.
Explain how over-use is depleting fisheries, forests, grasslands and croplands.

topics.title: Forests, law and the environment in India

concepts.learning_objective: Explain Article 48A and the author's criticism of weak enforcement of laws in India.
Interpret the data on the depletion of India's forests.
Recall the figures showing the rapid growth of world population.
Evaluate the author's argument linking development, family planning and poverty.
Explain the transcending concern and the role of industry in the Era of Responsibility.
Interpret the Thatcher and Lester Brown quotations about our duty to future generations.
Identify the themes of rationalism, hypocrisy and individuality in the poem.
Interpret the poet's feeling towards childhood and the poem's devices.
